single_best_answer.description: SBA: exactly one option is defensibly best. True for other types.

key_supported.description: The key or every marking-scheme point is entailed by its cited excerpt.

no_cueing.description: No grammatical, length, or wording cue to the key.

distractors_plausible.description: SBA: every distractor is plausible yet wrong. True for other types.

reasons.description: One short reason per failed check; [] on pass.
